## 🔎 Reviewer Checklist
*Reviewers: Please verify the following criteria before approving this pull request:*

### 🔍 Code Quality & Architecture
- [ ] **Clean Code:** Code follows the team's style guide and is easy to read.
- [ ] **No Redundancy:** No duplicate code, leftover console logs, or commented-out code blocks.
- [ ] **Architecture:** Changes align with architectural patterns and don't introduce technical debt.

### 🧪 Testing & Safety
- [ ] **Test Coverage:** Automated unit or integration tests have been added/updated.
- [ ] **Manual Verification:** Verified locally or in a staging environment.
- [ ] **Edge Cases:** Boundary conditions and potential failure points have been considered.

### 🛡️ Security & Performance
- [ ] **Data Safety:** No hardcoded secrets, API keys, or sensitive credentials.
- [ ] **Efficiency:** No obvious performance bottlenecks or unoptimized database queries.
